title: Bank Branch Performance Dashboard
shortDescription: Analyzed banking branch KPIs — deposits, loans, profitability, and complaints — with an interactive Streamlit dashboard and sentiment analysis.
problem: Branch managers lacked a unified view of financial performance across deposits, loans, expenses, revenue, and customer satisfaction — making it hard to spot underperforming branches quickly.
approach: Loaded and cleaned multi-branch transactional data using Pandas. Calculated key KPIs: profit margin, loan-to-deposit ratio, and complaint rate. Built an interactive Streamlit dashboard for real-time filtering and added TextBlob-powered sentiment analysis on customer feedback comments.
keyInsight: Identified 3 underperforming branches with negative profit margins — flagging them for cost-optimization reviews that reduced operational expenses.

title: Weather Monitor (IoT Dashboard)
shortDescription: Designed a real-time IoT weather station that streams live temperature & humidity data to a mobile app via Blynk.
problem: No low-cost, real-time solution existed for continuously monitoring indoor room climate data on a mobile device without expensive commercial sensors.
approach: Built an Arduino-based IoT weather station using DHT11 temperature/humidity sensors. Integrated with the Blynk IoT platform to stream live sensor readings to a mobile dashboard in real-time. Calibrated sensor thresholds for alert notifications.
keyInsight: Achieved live sensor data streaming with <2 second latency to mobile, demonstrating a complete data pipeline from physical sensor to digital dashboard.
